'''Lem Skarta''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Stationed on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], he ran a small shop, where he built and sold [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and other weaponry.<ref name="TOR" />
